name: Witch Doctor Uzer'i
summary: At Camp Mojache, Witch Doctor Uzer'i seeks to bind the spirits of powerful natural creatures into weapons for the Horde. He calls those lingering spirits muisek and studies magic the night elves have used for millennia.

sections.title: Harnessing the Muisek
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i studies Feralas's natural magic through the old rites of troll spiritualism. Night elves have drawn on forest beast spirits for millennia, and Uzer'i believes the Horde should claim that power. He calls a creature's lingering spirit muisek. His vessels shrink fallen beings and trap their spirits before they escape, so he can store and study their essence.

sections.title: Grisly Bargains and Ritual Vessels
sections.body: Uzer'i needed rare reagents to finish his vessels. After killing an Alliance dwarf in the Feralas timber, he severed the dwarf's head and arranged a trade with Neeru Fireblade, a warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. Neeru gave him rare herbs for the grisly prize, and Uzer'i completed his first vessels. He could then capture the spirits of local wildkin, hippogryphs, faerie dragons, treants, and mountain giants.

sections.title: Forging Weapons of Spirit
sections.body: Capturing muisek is only the beginning of Uzer'i's ambition. He gathers sinew, enchanted minerals, and petrified splintered logs from the creatures whose spirits he traps. Then he joins those materials with bound muisek. Through his rites, he binds ancient forest spirits into weapons for the Horde. Uzer'i also follows rumors of hidden places of power across Azeroth, including the ancient, submerged Sunken Temple.

faq.answer: Muisek is the lingering spiritual essence of living creatures. Uzer'i uses enchanted vessels to shrink slain beasts and natural guardians, trapping their spirits before they disperse.

faq.q: Why is Uzer'i trading dwarf heads to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Uzer'i needed rare reagents for his ritual vessels. After killing an Alliance dwarf in Feralas, he traded the severed head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar for herbs to bind muisek spirits.

faq.q: What kind of creatures does Uzer'i target?
faq.answer: Uzer'i targets creatures tied to the natural world and long allied with the night elves. They include wildkin from the Hinterlands, along with hippogryphs, faerie dragons, treants, and mountain giants in Feralas.

faq.q: What does Uzer'i do with the captured spirits?
faq.answer: Uzer'i joins captured muisek with natural materials such as splintered logs, sinew, and minerals. He binds the spirits into weapons, giving them the power of ancient forest guardians.

faq.q: Where is Witch Doctor Uzer'i located?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i lives at Camp Mojache, the Horde's main settlement beneath central Feralas's canopy.

faq.q: What does Uzer'i know about the Sunken Temple?
faq.answer: Uzer'i has heard of the submerged Atal'ai sanctuary called the Sunken Temple. He directs those who want to investigate it to Marvon Rivetseeker, a goblin explorer.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see Uzer'i's work to master Kalimdor's primal magic and turn it against the Alliance, including the night elves.
As a troll, you can recognize Uzer'i's traditional witch doctor rites, shrunken vessels, and voodoo used to harness life essences.
As a shaman, you can recognize Uzer'i's focus on communion with spirits. His forceful capture of elemental and wild essences favors witchery over reverent balance.
As a night elf, you can see why Uzer'i's practices are blasphemous. Sacred treants, hippogryphs, and mountain giants are killed and bound into weapons.
